description: PROVINCIA SONDRIO - MAPPA DEGLI SCARICHI is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by experience.arcgis.com. The discharge map service of the Province of Sondrio has two purposes: one is purely statistical and environmental, which is to assess the presence and concentration of discharges in the various areas of the provincial territory and the other is more operational because knowledge of the coordinates of the discharge points due to the constraints ... Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "PROVINCE SONDRIO - DOWNLOAD MAP" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include ambiente, aree protette e difesa del suolo, pianificazione. The listing shows 2025-11-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
